question: Should this PR be allowed to run a vendored MathJax bundle as same-origin Control UI code, and what default math delimiter policy should core accept?
rationale: The code can render math in principle, but accepting opaque browser code and global `$...$` parsing changes the Control UI security and compatibility boundary in a way automation should not decide.

options.title: Require tracked provenance and explicit delimiters
options.body: Replace the opaque bundle with package/build/license provenance and remove `$...$` parsing unless maintainers explicitly accept that compatibility change.

options.title: Accept owner-approved vendoring
options.body: Allow a vendored MathJax asset only with documented source, version, license, update process, and security review.

options.title: Pause for the canonical feature issue
options.body: Keep this branch open or close it later in favor of the canonical Control UI math-rendering discussion if the core direction is not accepted.

recommendation.title: Require tracked provenance and explicit delimiters
recommendation.body: Replace the opaque bundle with package/build/license provenance and remove `$...$` parsing unless maintainers explicitly accept that compatibility change.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is connected to the earlier Control UI markdown/config history and is the best available owner for the product/security acceptance choice.
